breakdown.description: For a two-phase semicrystalline polymer, the measured density should lie between the amorphous and crystalline reference densities, but the setup gives a sample density higher than the crystalline density.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt provided a physically impossible measured density (1.42 g/cm^3) that was higher than the crystalline density (1.30 g/cm^3). The ground truth corrected this value to 1.22 g/cm^3. The agent, however, repeated the incorrect value of 1.42 g/cm^3 in its generated specification, failing to fix the error.
